evidence: decorative_mascot: Data slides along the bars at hook@0.3 and seg0:end, stands on the line at seg1:start and seg1:end, rides the edge of the bar at seg3:start through seg3:end, and stands on a track at seg4. He never does a bit about ships or cargo; he is only a position marker.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: Frames hook@0.3 through seg0:end show a four-row horizontal bar chart titled 'largest container ship capacity by year', with Data standing on a bar. There is no ship, no box and no truck. The hook's '24,000 truckloads' is only a caption.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The ship-growth relationship fell back to the default ranked-bars chart, so the video opens on a slow chart build instead of the subject.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Open on the ship itself: a hull whose deck fills with stacked containers to 6,600, then stretches and restacks to 12,500 and 24,000, with Data craning boxes on until the ship dwarfs a line of trucks. The number should be the stack, not a bar.
